notes.title: UPDATE NOW LIVE | Achievements Added, Soundtrack Now Available to Purchase
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26236864/20d73d584f8c2ff9422a7129f8995726b0488703.png

Hello all,

Welcome to Dad Quest's new update! This brings achievements, as well as some new customisation options and an update to the game's finale. Read on for the full patch notes!

Official Soundtrack Now Available!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26236864/b183e8b286cb3a29dbd4094db19a766a2ae0161e.png

You are now able to purchase the Dad Quest official soundtrack, which consists of a whopping 36 tracks. Click here to find out more.

Full Patch Notes

ACHIEVEMENTS IMPLEMENTED

Visuals

8 new child hats added
1 new child body added
New CEO gun animation
New bank teller texture
New bank tailor npc model
Updated the Dadges’ art assets

Finale Updates

Final fight polish + bug fixes
Post final fight animation + sequence polish
End sequence dialogue revisions
SFX added to final sequence
Player now gets the Good Dadge from the CEO after final fight

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26236864/6499e46d4000528e6cd564d9a62c0d100af3c01d.gif

New Outfits

Added outfits to secret area left of Beach accessible through sprint
Added 2 outfit chests to The Gated
Trash King Vigil gives player a new hat
Bank Tailor gives player the Dove Remastered outfit
Added some outfits to a few Gravel Pit rest floors
Added some outfits to end of DarkTM dungeon
All outfits now attainable in-game

End Credits

Font changes in credits
Backer names sorted alphabetically
Devs portrait + Regional Dad portraits added to end-of-game credits
DQ logo added to end-of-game credits

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26236864/1313054904d943f96d206df3e8fa6f047a7344fe.gif

Misc Adjustments

Support added for 3 additional keyboard layouts (AZERTY, QWERTZ, and Dvorak-US)
Input prompt textures added for additional keyboard layouts
Correct dialogue for bottom of gravel pit
Added additional backer to The Gated
Minor NPC positioning updates
Font changes in outfit menu
Volume adjustments
Shooting Gallery random prizes prioritize Common/Uncommon/Rare toys the player has not discovered yet

Other Bug Fixes

Fixed issues caused by non-US Windows Region Settings
Dadge icon ordering bug

Thanks,
The Dad Quest Team

notes.title: FemDad Update Now Live
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The FemDad update is now live for all of you to enjoy.
We are excited for everyone to play our new character this Father's day.

Here are the full list of changes for this build

Change Log

Brand new FemDad character
New Toys and toy effects
New HUD art
New pause menu
Sparkly Gravel
Level Up Buildings are back!
No more EXP! Gravel is king
New levelling system
Restore health points with gravel
Summoning changes
Environment art polish
New cut scenes


Additional Notes

Old save data sadly will not work with the new update, this is mainly because of the changes to the EXP system and gravel system. It is best to start a fresh save and even give the new FemDad a go while you are at it.
There are plans to rework the current Tutorial in the new future to make things easier to understand and to explain the game mechanics is the best way possible


Thank you all again for your continued support, if you do have any feedback or queries please feel free to use the forum.

https://youtu.be/2sUaXrElRq0

notes.title: Fem Dad Update Arrives in Time for Father's Day
notes.notes:
This Father's Day weekend, Dad Quest receives its first major content update! In what must be one of the first ever Father's Day-themed content releases in gaming history, we're adding an entirely new playable character, Fem Dad, along with a dollop of polish to the game's existing content!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26236864/48dddd8a64693f80de39b2240d61c9cd3544dbad.png

From brand new art assets for pigeons and gravel (Dad Quest's currency), to a revamped tutorial, developer Sundae Month has made this an update worthy of the occasion. 

Check out some of the most prominent new features and tweaks below:

- New models for enemy pigeons.
- New art asset for the Gravel, which acts as currency in Dad Quest.
- Updated tutorial to reflect some new content.
- New levelling system for the Child. Throwing your Child through buildings now levels them up.
- Updated Desert Dungeon, visually, with more decorations.
- Healing system tweaked.
- Level progression has been updated to be a little more forgiving, but still difficult.
- Exp has been removed. Everything is now purchased with Gravel.
- Enemies now deal damage on contact.
- Toys are now more of a focus for Children.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26236864/6a1eb3a5f40aa3ed176fcd0d6e7e2601fa47e509.png

Last but not least, we've just released a brand new trailer, which highlights Fem Dad in all her ass-kicking glory. Make sure to watch until the very end, however, for a sneak peak at what's next for Dad Quest in the coming months...
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2sUaXrElRq0
So there you have it! We've been hard at work to make the content available for Father's Day, so go and make us proud by either revisiting the game, or checking it out if you haven't already! There's much, much more to come from Sundae Month and Excalibur Games in the coming month, including Chapter 2, which will be by far our biggest Dad Quest update yet!

The Father's Day update will be released either today, 16th June, or tomorrow, 17th June!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26236864/54252b6bbad8f2cfe272e50bb2f82b3f01eb4c84.png

notes.title: Dad Quest Update 10th of April 2017
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We're hoping to reveal some more news regarding upcoming content very soon, the team are currently at school and as we are approaching some holidays they will be focusing on some more content within the next few weeks :D

While today's update doesn't feature much new content, the team are working towards the next chapter. Today's update includes some fixes, and the start of some work to come.

ChangeLog
A sound issue that caused the game to crash has been fixed
Updated portions of dialogue
 Fixed the Petrichor book in the Library
The game is now ported to a new version of the Monogame engine


If you come across any issues, do let us know in the forums and the team will look into it.

notes.title: Dad Quest Update 17th March 2017 - Controller Support, Crate Particles, PIGS!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today we have released a new build for Dad Quest, the key part of this update is the beta update which allows controller support.

You can play the game in its entirety with  360 controller support, however the game UI is not yet complete and still displays the PC controls when talking with NPC’s etc. This is something that will be worked on throughout development. Here is the current controls

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26236864/63840b651d21b82f4682e0a9fc3509be7c8a79b2.png

Left Stick – Control dad movement
Right Stick – Control direction of your throw
Left Trigger – Throw child
Right Trigger – Melee with child
A button – Jump
Left/ Right Bumper - Jump
X button – Interact
Y button – Open inventory
Start - Pause

The 360 controller is currently in beta itself and may be refined during the development of dad Quest. Additionally some issues may arise from using a 360 controller. Like this Moonwalking Dad

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dMJ9sWctjBQ
If you come across any irregularities, let us know!

Additionally, a few more changes have been made to the build including some new particle effects for destroying crates and Pigs are now dangerous.

Full changelog below:

-Beta controller support added
-Controller controls visible from pause menu
-Crate break particles
-Exp orbs bounce off child if at max level
-Pigs
-NPC updates
-Miscellaneous bug fixes
-Do not trust the desert guard

As usual, if you come across any issues, do let us know in the forums along with any steps on how to reproduce it.

Have a great weekend guys!

notes.title: March 2nd Update - A few fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are all very pleased with the response from the community for Dad Quest. some great coverage from some youtubers and twitch streamers and many of you have left some great positive reviews on the game. Thank you everyone for the support and I hope that over the coming months we can deliver on a great, fun action platformer.

Of course, keep your suggestions and ideas coming, we are in the process of refining the next couple of months development and will hope to share some more news very soon.

Today we are releasing an update which includes a few bug fixes. A short change Log is below:

- Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck after talking to the CEO
- Fixed an issue where the game crashes if it can not find an audio device
- Fixed a few bugs with the prophecy dialogue
- Several other bugs addressed

This week has been predominately bug stomping. But the team are still working on new content and I hope next week we'll be able to share some details.

Do get in touch with us in the forums if you have any suggestions or any bugs to report.

notes.title: 22nd February - Patch Update, Trailer, Let's Plays!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26236864/e0ad33cfc439de2fa41b80f37ab7d397c8f80bdc.png

Hello everyone,

We are one single day away from the release of Dad Quest in Early Access. For those of you who received advanced copies via Kickstarter, we've just released a new build which contains fixes for several issues and a few minor additions.

First up, A new trailer has just been made live, you can check it out here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=__LqJKqAwqw

We've also had some awesome Youtubers play the game, here are just a few:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zh2RvbaD1ro

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u96C-rPLx8s

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dgxUu5lsAhI&

There is plenty of other coverage including Yogscast's Hannah who streamed the game via Twitch! Overall, we've seen a lot of people enjoy the game and we're looking forward to developing Dad Quest further.

Today's patch highlights include:
- Fixed an issue where the world would not load textures
- Dad now extends his arm to try and recall child with Left Click
- Tutorial Area now teaches players how to recall the child
- Added a notification which tells players when the current content of Early Access has ended (Don't worry, more stuff will come soon!)
- Some work done to improve some memory issues
- Several Bug fixes

If you come across any issues, let us know in the forums or email us at support@excalibur-publishing.com with as much information as possible.

notes.title: Inventory Update - Earliest Access Version
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have recently updated the game for our Earliest Access players (The few folks who get to play the game before the 23rd of February as they were Kickstarter backers). Today has been just a small user interface update which allows you to hover over an item in your inventory to see a small pop up window which has a description of the item.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26236864/2beb0b2c2179d47f19ea8d473cf7c735d7ee7186.png

You can drag these items into your childs inventory and give them new abilities including burn damage or even healing the dad. There is still some more work we need to do on this but if anyone has any feedback, do let us know.

A few other big fixes have also been included in this build.

All the best,
Chris
